[RDSC.16.2.8] **`requires` is computed from content.** The compiler must
list in `requires` exactly the capabilities whose code the artefact's
content needs, whatever the settings: a capability can be `true` and
unused. A strategy that is set (`realtime`, `constspace`) has no use site
and is needed all the same: it decides how the engine carries out the whole
program, so it is listed whenever it is `true`.

**A runtime trusts `requires`** ([RDSC.9.9]). It
compares `requires` against its build ([RDSC.16.2.7]) and does not check it
against the content. An artefact that did not come from a conforming compiler
carries no guarantee that its `requires` names every capability its content
needs.
